title: Frontend Engineer Intern
description: Build responsive user interfaces for our analytics dashboard using React and TypeScript. You will write reusable components, style them with CSS and Tailwind, and call REST APIs.

title: Junior Web Developer
description: Create marketing websites and landing pages with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Experience with React or Vue is a plus. You will work closely with designers in Figma.

title: UI Engineer
description: Own the component library for our web app. Strong TypeScript and React skills required, plus accessibility, testing with Jest, and Next.js server rendering.

title: Web Application Developer Co-op
description: Develop patient-facing web pages in Angular and TypeScript. Write unit tests, fix browser layout bugs in CSS, and consume GraphQL APIs.

title: Backend Engineer Intern
description: Design and build REST APIs in Python with FastAPI. Work with PostgreSQL, write SQL queries, add tests with pytest, and package services with Docker.

title: Software Engineer, Platform
description: Build high-throughput services in Go and Java. You will work with Kafka, Redis caching, PostgreSQL, and gRPC between microservices.

title: Server Developer Co-op
description: Maintain a Node.js and Express API used by our mobile app. Write SQL for MySQL, add authentication, and handle database migrations.

title: API Developer
description: Develop payment APIs in Java with Spring Boot. Requires SQL, REST design, unit testing, and experience with message queues such as RabbitMQ.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Train and evaluate deep learning models in Python with PyTorch. You will prepare datasets with pandas and NumPy, run experiments, and report metrics.

title: Data Scientist, New Grad
description: Analyse customer data with Python, pandas and SQL. Build predictive models with scikit-learn, and present findings with clear statistics and charts.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Fine-tune transformer models with Hugging Face and PyTorch for text classification. Work with embeddings, vector search, and LLM evaluation.

title: Data Engineer Co-op
description: Build data pipelines in Python and SQL with Airflow and Spark. Load data into a warehouse, write dbt models, and monitor data quality.

title: DevOps Engineer Intern
description: Automate deployments with Docker, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions. Write Terraform for AWS infrastructure and improve CI/CD pipelines on Linux.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description: Keep production services healthy. You will work with Kubernetes, Prometheus and Grafana monitoring, Linux, Bash scripting, and incident response.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Co-op
description: Provision cloud resources on AWS and Azure with Terraform. Containerize applications with Docker and set up CI/CD in Jenkins.

title: Build and Release Engineer
description: Own the build pipeline. Requires Python and Bash scripting, Git, Jenkins, Docker, and experience keeping Linux build machines running.

title: iOS Developer Intern
description: Build features for our hiking app in Swift and SwiftUI. Work with REST APIs, local storage, and submit builds to the App Store.

title: Android Developer
description: Develop our transit app in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose. Requires Android SDK experience, REST APIs, and unit testing.

title: Mobile Engineer Co-op
description: Ship cross-platform features in React Native and TypeScript. Integrate push notifications, Firebase, and REST APIs for iOS and Android.

title: Flutter Developer
description: Build a caregiver scheduling app with Flutter and Dart. Work with Firebase authentication, offline storage, and app store releases.

title: Security Analyst Intern
description: Monitor alerts in our SIEM, investigate suspicious activity, and help with vulnerability scanning. Knowledge of networking, Linux and Python scripting is useful.

title: Application Security Engineer
description: Review code for security flaws, run penetration testing, and teach teams about the OWASP top ten. Requires Python or Java and threat modelling.

title: Cloud Security Co-op
description: Audit AWS accounts for misconfigurations, review identity and access policies, and automate checks with Python and Terraform.

title: Network Security Associate
description: Configure firewalls and VPNs, analyse network traffic, and respond to incidents. Requires networking fundamentals and Linux administration.
